name: Back Squat
description: Barbell on upper back, squat to depth, drive through mid-foot.

name: Front Squat
description: Barbell racked on front delts, more upright torso than back squat.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip hinge with slight knee bend, bar close to legs, stretch through the hamstrings.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: Full hip hinge from the floor, posterior chain dominant.

name: Bench Press
description: Flat barbell press, elbows tucked slightly, bar to sternum.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press on an incline bench, upper chest emphasis.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinged bent-over row, pull to lower ribs.

name: Pull-Up
description: Overhand grip, chin over bar, full hang at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Cable machine pulldown, controlled eccentric.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing strict press, bar path close to the face.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Isolation raise to shoulder height, light control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: Shoulders on bench, drive hips up, squeeze at top.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Alternating forward lunge, holding dumbbells at sides.

name: Plank
description: Forearm plank, neutral spine, brace throughout.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from bar, raise legs to hip height or above.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Standing curl, elbows pinned to sides.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Cable pushdown, elbows locked to torso.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Ballistic hip hinge, power from the hips not the arms.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Kettlebell held at chest, squat between the knees.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: Heavy carry, braced core, controlled walk.
